import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def task_func(df, target_values=[1, 3, 4]):
    work_df = df.copy()
    target_set = set(target_values)

    if hasattr(work_df, "columns") and len(work_df.columns) > 0:
        work_df = work_df.where(work_df.isin(target_set), 0)

        n_cols = len(work_df.columns)
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_cols, 1, figsize=(8, 4 * n_cols))

        if n_cols == 1:
            axes = [axes]

        for ax, col in zip(axes, work_df.columns):
            sns.countplot(x=work_df[col], ax=ax, color="steelblue")
            ax.set_title(str(col))
            ax.set_xlabel(str(col))
            ax.set_ylabel("Count")
            ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)

        plt.tight_layout()
        return axes[0]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
    ax.set_axis_off()
    return ax
